Package dev.px.core.util

Interface CoreLogger

All Known Implementing Classes:
ConsoleLogger
public interface CoreLogger
Minimal logging seam.

Core avoids a hard dependency on log4j so it stays compilable without Minecraft on the classpath. Adapters normally hand Core a delegate to the game logger; ConsoleLogger covers the rest.
